```plato
// One node of a flat planar scalar-field expression graph: a single operation
// carrying exactly the operands it consumes. FieldNodeIndex fields are node
// indices into the owning graph; FieldIndex is an index into an external list
// of planar scalar fields; Constant carries a literal. Lerp's Weight and Clamp's/Remap's
// bounds are themselves nodes; Remap linearly maps Input from [FromLow, FromHigh]
// onto the unit range [0, 1].
type ScalarFieldNode2D
    implements IValue
    = Source(FieldIndex: ItemIndex)                              // read an external planar scalar field
    | Constant(Value: Number)                                    // a literal constant
    | Add(Left: FieldNodeIndex, Right: FieldNodeIndex)                         // Left + Right
    | Subtract(Left: FieldNodeIndex, Right: FieldNodeIndex)                    // Left - Right
    | Multiply(Left: FieldNodeIndex, Right: FieldNodeIndex)                    // Left * Right
    | Divide(Left: FieldNodeIndex, Right: FieldNodeIndex)                      // Left / Right
    | Minimum(Left: FieldNodeIndex, Right: FieldNodeIndex)                     // min(Left, Right)
    | Maximum(Left: FieldNodeIndex, Right: FieldNodeIndex)                     // max(Left, Right)
    | Negate(Input: FieldNodeIndex)                                            // -Input
    | AbsoluteValue(Input: FieldNodeIndex)                                     // |Input|
    | Lerp(A: FieldNodeIndex, B: FieldNodeIndex, Weight: FieldNodeIndex)       // A blended toward B by Weight
    | Clamp(Input: FieldNodeIndex, Low: FieldNodeIndex, High: FieldNodeIndex)  // Input clamped to [Low, High]
    | Remap(Input: FieldNodeIndex, FromLow: FieldNodeIndex, FromHigh: FieldNodeIndex) // Input remapped from [FromLow, FromHigh] to [0, 1]
    | Threshold(Input: FieldNodeIndex, Level: FieldNodeIndex);                 // 1 where Input >= Level, else 0
```
